_comment: Size, asset and Play-readiness budgets for CI (tool/ci/check_assets.py, tool/ci/check_apk.py). Sizes in KiB. null = report only. apk.release_arm64 is enforced by the 'Release size and Play readiness (arm64)' job. Raise a budget only in a reviewed PR that says why.

assets._sizing: Redesign plan: Figtree 400/500/600/700 (.ttf, ~160 KiB, OFL.txt alongside) + NotoSansDevanagari-Regular for PDFs (238 KiB, PR #14) = 5 font files, ~400 KiB. One spare font slot; ~600 KiB left for images.

banned.google_fonts: downloads fonts from Google at runtime (network request, offline gaps, privacy). Bundle the font files under assets/fonts/ with their licence instead.
banned.flutter_dotenv: runtime .env files are not allowed. Use --dart-define for non-secret build switches only; secrets never ship in the app.
banned.envied: embeds secrets in the app binary. Secrets never ship in the app.

packages.needs_signoff_note: Any new direct dependency is listed in the job summary and needs DevOps + security sign-off on the PR (size, permissions, network use, licence).

release_arm64._baseline: PR #21 run 40068366351 (main code + CI branches, 2026-10-24): APK 35951 KiB (incl. ~9096 KiB SQLCipher libs for armeabi-v7a/x86_64), arm64 phone estimate 26855, libapp.so 6785, flutter_assets 501, dex 2362. Budgets = baseline + headroom for the redesign (Figtree + Noto fonts ~400 KiB, new screens).
